user_query: I want to create a professional email signature with QR codes and my LinkedIn profile link.

TaskList.description: Gather the user's contact details including name, job title, phone number, and email address to encode in the QR code.
Generate a QR code with the user's contact details.
Obtain the company logo for inclusion in the email signature design.
Assemble the email signature layout with the contact QR code, company logo, and LinkedIn profile link.
Generate a QR code for the user's LinkedIn profile URL.
